backend/main.mo: Main canister actor handling user profiles, Stripe checkout/session management, data plan storage, and permission‑checked admin/user actions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting an optional single bankDetails field into a mutable array of bank account records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing frontend files, components, and requirements for multi‑account bank transfer updates and related UI changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Reference file containing short human‑written summaries for major frontend components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining the app’s OKLCH color palette and light/dark mode tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component with simple path-based routing for success/failure pages and global React Query provider.
frontend/src/components/DataPlansSection: Data plans UI with network selection, plan cards, WhatsApp/Stripe actions, and multi‑account bank transfer dialog support.
frontend/src/components/IBNFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick links, contact details, and social icons, including scroll-to-section and WhatsApp support links.
frontend/src/components/IBNHeader.tsx: Displays the site header with branding, WhatsApp contact button, and admin setup menus for Stripe and bank transfer configuration.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Composes the landing page layout including hero content, features, data plans, how-it-works, testimonials, FAQ, and CTA sections.
frontend/src/components/LandingPageSecti: Shows a FAQ accordion listing common customer questions and answers about data plans and support.
Provides a three-step explanation of how to purchase and receive data using card components and icons.
Renders customer testimonials with ratings, avatars, and roles inside card components.
frontend/src/components/payments/BankTra: Admin form for creating, editing, validating, and saving multiple bank transfer accounts using backend queries.
Dialog showing selectable bank account details, copy-to-clipboard actions, and optional order summary for bank-transfer payments.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Page displayed after a failed or cancelled payment with options to retry or contact support via WhatsApp.
Page verifying Stripe session status and displaying success, failure, or verification error states after checkout.
frontend/src/components/payments/PayNowB: Button that checks login, creates a Stripe checkout session, handles redirects, and shows a login prompt if needed.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin form for configuring Stripe secret key and allowed countries, with validation and status display.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppCTA.tsx: A reusable button component linking to WhatsApp with optional custom message and number display.
frontend/src/data/mobileNetworkPlans.ts: Defines mobile network types and exports a list of structured data plan objects for MTN, GLO, AIRTEL, and 9MOBILE.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for managing login, identity state, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for Stripe setup, checkout sessions, bank account management, and admin checks using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind configuration defining light and dark theme variables and base global styles.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Utility functions to generate WhatsApp URLs with optional pre-filled messages for orders and bank transfer confirmations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Offers helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS config enabling dark mode, custom theme extensions, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's state, version, requirements, and architectural notes for building the IBN data‑selling application with payment and UI features.
